workingProcess.heading: The Agentic
workingProcess.description: We don't just write code. We map your entire operational workflow to identify where agents can autonomously act, decision-make, and execute.

steps.title: Discovery & Blueprinting
steps.description: We don't just ask what you need. We map your entire operational workflow to identify where agents can autonomously act, decision-make, and execute.

steps.title: Logic & Tool Design
steps.description: We define the agent's 'brain'—its instructions, guardrails, and the specific APIs/tools it needs to access your data and perform actions.

steps.title: Development & Integration
steps.description: We build the core agent architecture, connecting it securely to your CRM, database, or internal APIs. No black boxes—just clean, auditable code.

steps.title: Simulation & Alignment
steps.description: Before going live, we run the agent in a sandbox environment, simulating thousands of scenarios to ensure it behaves exactly as intended.

steps.title: Deployment & Orchestration
steps.description: We deploy your agents into a monitored environment where they run 24/7. We track performance, cost, and accuracy in real-time.

questions.question: How long does it take to build a custom AI agent?
questions.answer: Most projects start with a 2-4 week Proof of Concept phase. From there, a production-ready agent typically takes 6-12 weeks depending on the complexity of integrations and the scope of autonomous capabilities required.

questions.question: Do you offer a Proof of Concept before full commitment?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We strongly recommend starting with a POC. It lets us validate the technical feasibility and demonstrate real value before you commit to a full build. It's the fastest way to see if this is the right solution for you.

questions.question: What if my requirements change mid-project?
questions.answer: That's expected. We build in iterative cycles specifically so we can adapt. Requirements evolve as you see the system in action. We handle scope changes gracefully, as long as we're aligned on priorities.

questions.question: How secure is my data with IntellAgent?
questions.answer: Security is foundational, not an afterthought. We use industry-standard encryption, secure API handling, and strict access controls. Your data and your customers' data are treated with the highest level of confidentiality.

questions.question: Can your agents integrate with our existing tools (CRM, Slack, etc.)?
questions.answer: Yes. Our agents are designed to connect to real systems. We've integrated with Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion, Slack, custom databases, and many others. If it has an API, we can likely plug into it.

questions.question: What makes IntellAgent different from other AI vendors?
questions.answer: We build systems that act, not just respond. Most vendors offer chatbots. We build autonomous agents that can execute multi-step workflows, make decisions, and integrate deeply into your operations. We focus on production-grade reliability, not just demos.

whatWeBuild.subheading: Each system here solves a real problem, not a pitch-deck problem.

projects.title: Sales Team Automation Agent
projects.problem: Sales teams waste hours navigating CRM dashboards and piecing together reports to answer basic questions. Critical insights get lost in data sprawl, slowing down deals and decision-making when speed matters most.
projects.solution: An AI agent that connects to your CRM and uses specialized tools to instantly surface the data you need delivered in plain English. Instead of building reports or clicking through dashboards, your team simply asks questions and gets answers. The agent handles complex data queries behind the scenes, turning your CRM into a conversational intelligence layer.
projects.impact: Cuts report generation time by 60%. Delivers instant answers to questions like 'Which deals are stalling?' or 'What's my team's forecast looking like?'. Eliminates dashboard fatigue your sales data becomes as easy to access as sending a text.

projects.title: Voice Customer Support Agent
projects.problem: Your customers hate waiting on hold, and your support team drowns in the same questions every day. Long wait times kill customer satisfaction and drive people to your competitors.
projects.solution: An AI phone agent that answers customer calls instantly no hold music, no menus to navigate. It talks like a real person, handles interruptions naturally, and has instant access to all your company knowledge to answer questions accurately. When it can't help, it transfers smoothly to your human team. It can handle hundreds of calls at once, 24/7.
projects.impact: Answers 80% of common questions without human help. Zero wait times, even during peak hours. Saves your team from repetitive calls so they can focus on complex issues. Customizable voice and personality to match your brand.

projects.title: Web Intelligence Agent
projects.problem: You need insights from competitor websites, market data, or public information but manually tracking changes and spotting patterns across multiple sites is impossible at scale.
projects.solution: An AI system that continuously monitors the websites you care about, extracts the exact data points you need, and automatically surfaces patterns and insights. We've built it to be incredibly cost-efficient, it doesn't waste resources re-reading entire websites. Instead, it maintains a smart knowledge base and only processes what matters, delivering actionable intelligence in plain English.
projects.impact: Tracks competitors, pricing, inventory, or any public data automatically. Spots trends and changes you'd never catch manually. Delivers insights, not spreadsheets, AI explains what the data actually means. Runs continuously at a fraction of the cost of traditional monitoring solutions.

projects.title: WhatsApp Automation (Playwright)
projects.problem: Businesses need to engage customers where they are, on WhatsApp. But official APIs are often restrictive, and broadcast tools lack true conversational capability.
projects.solution: An end-to-end conversational automation system using Playwright. It mimics human interaction patterns to manage complex booking flows, customer queries, and notification systems directly through the web interface.
projects.impact: True two-way conversational automation. higher engagement rates. seamless integration into existing support workflows.

philosophy.text: We don’t just build software. We build digital cognition.

research.heading: Applied Research & Experimental Interfaces
research.toneBlock: We believe that the future of software interaction is agentic, multimodal, and fluid. Our research division explores the boundaries of what is possible when you combine Large Language Models with real-time audio synthesis, computer vision, and autonomous browser execution. We don't just theorize; we build proofs-of-concept that challenge the status quo of static user interfaces.

topics.title: Generative Audio & Voice Synthesis
topics.description: Investigating low-latency voice pipelines for conversational agents. We focus on interrupting capabilities, emotional modulation, and seamless turn-taking to create indistinguishable human-AI interactions.
topics.details: Current benchmarks on our proprietary voice stack show < 500ms latency from audio-input to audio-output.

topics.title: Autonomous Browser Agents
topics.description: Developing robust browser automation agents that can navigate complex, dynamic web applications. Unlike traditional scrapers, these agents use vision models to 'see' the page and make decisions based on visual context.
topics.details: Successfully navigating modern SPAs with 99% reliability in controlled environments.

topics.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
topics.description: Exploring architectures for swarms of specialized agents working together. We are building frameworks where a 'Planner' agent delegates tasks to 'Worker' agents (coders, researchers, writers) to solve complex, multi-step problems autonomously.
topics.details: Our 'Swarm' prototype can now independently research a topic, write a report, and generate a slide deck.

topics.title: Generative UI (GenUI)
topics.description: Moving beyond static dashboards. We are researching interfaces that generate themselves in real-time based on the user's intent and the data at hand. An interface that adapts to you, not the other way around.
topics.details: Early prototypes demonstrate dynamic form generation and adaptive data visualization.
